animations.priority: night (sleeping) > overdue/thirsty > weather > battery. A sleeping pet sleeps even if sunny; a thirsty pet looks thirsty even on a full battery. Battery unknown (web) = neutral energy, never a faked level.

states.idle: Bounce: 4 frames, dy = 0, -2, 0, -1 cells, 140 ms per frame, loop. Leaf wiggle: one leaf cell flips L<->l every ~4 s, never constant.
states.sparkle: One 3-cell sparkle twinkle at a random leaf edge every 5-9 s, 600 ms fade. Never more than one at a time.

states.idle: Slower bounce: dy = 0, -1, 0 cells, 260 ms per frame. Head zone leans 1 cell toward the water-can button side every few seconds, then back.
Droop: whole foliage rendered 2 cells lower with a 1-cell side-to-side wilt sway, 500 ms per frame. Colours shift to the muted leaf set (leafMuted). No bounce.

states.sequence: 1) 10 droplet particles fall over the pet, 700 ms. 2) Splash ripple ring at soil line, 400 ms. 3) Pet jumps 4 cells and back, 500 ms, with 6 sparkles. 4) Soil darkens one shade for ~10 s. Total under 2 s. Plays ONLY after the save is verified (PLAN bug #7), and only if sound is on for the blip.

states.modifier: Bounce speed x1.4 and bounce height +1 cell on top of the watering state, except when sleeping or thirsty (priority order wins).
Slow blink every 3 s (eyes closed 200 ms), heavy-lid face, bounce removed. If the pet is thirsty, thirsty wins and this modifier is dropped.
Face tilts 1 cell up (face anchor -1 row), relaxed sway 800 ms per frame, 2 sun-glint sparkles near the top leaves every ~6 s.

Whole foliage sways 1-2 cells in the wind direction, 300 ms per frame; stronger gusts (builder maps gust speed to sway amplitude, capped at 2 cells) bend the pet briefly. Soft whoosh blip only on tap, never ambient.
6-10 pixel raindrops fall across the scene, 900 ms loop; tiny 1-cell splashes where drops hit leaves; foliage perks 1 cell up while raining.
Slow flakes fall (8 flakes, 2 s loop); pet trembles ±1 cell horizontally at 120 ms; one breath-puff pixel pair appears beside the face every ~4 s.

Scene dimmed with a dark-blue overlay (never black); stars twinkle (3 stars, 1 s cycle); 'Z' pixels (2 cells) float up from the face, 2 s loop; slow breathing bob: foliage dy = 0, +1 cell over 2 s, back over 2 s. Overrides everything else.

cell_palette.D: leafDark (unused in these archetype grids; reserved for shading passes)

faces.note: K = eye dark, W = eye glint (white, 1 cell), M = mouth dark, Z = sleep pixel. Faces are 12 wide x 5 tall.

grid_rules.cell: One grid cell = one chunky pixel. Never interpolate or smooth.
grid_rules.face_anchor: Face grid is centred horizontally on the foliage grid at the archetype's face_top_row (trailing 2, upright 9, rosette 4). Those rows were chosen so eyes and mouth land on dense foliage, never in a hollow gap. Builder: if a face lands on empty cells for a real photo avatar, nudge the anchor +/-1 row toward the densest nearby row; never leave eyes floating on background.
grid_rules.readability_rule: At 120 px wide the silhouette (foliage + pot) and the eyes must still read. Verified on the three sample renders in design/previews/ (see DESIGN.md §9).
grid_rules.foliage_width: Per archetype (see width field: trailing 26, upright 25, rosette 24). Pot (24 wide) is centred under the foliage.

note: Designer deliverable for PlantPal (PLAN.md §2, §5, §7). Code-drawn originals only: no ripped sprites, no stock art, no generated images. The builder renders these grids with CustomPainter (hard edges, no smoothing, no anti-aliasing). Face grids overlay the foliage grid at render time, so mood changes never require re-pixelating. Grid letters map to palette keys in DESIGN.md.

pot.note: Soil row (s) sits on top of the pot rim. When the pet is watered, render soil one shade darker for ~10 s (the 'soil darkens' beat in the watering celebration), then back to normal.
